data.body:
AC7 root cause established, and it resolves the disagreement recorded earlier rather than picking a side.

Both observations were true and describe opposite ends of the same unmediated path. The original incident was live-ahead-of-main: production was applied from HCL that had not landed, so main subsequently planned destroys. The current state is main-ahead-of-live: terraform-drift.yml is plan-only under the read-only rebar-terraform-plan role, no terraform apply exists anywhere in CI, and run 35555452105 planned 8 to add, 3 to change, 0 to destroy. Divergence in either direction is the same defect.

The shared root cause: production Terraform mutation was a manual bare-apply path with no executable requirement that the tree being applied be the fetched origin/main tip. Nothing enforced the relationship between what was applied and what had landed, so the two could drift apart either way.

A CI apply lane was considered and rejected on evidence, not preference. ADR 0079 deliberately declines to establish GitHub-to-AWS deploy trust, and a GitHub-only trigger would fail the project.portability criterion for lack of a non-CI fallback.

Remedy, in Gerrit change 3029 (commit f3d72662bb4): scripts/terraform_prod.py, an operation-linked wrapper that refuses a production plan or apply unless the checkout is the fetched origin/main tip, writes a sidecar binding each saved plan to its commit and root, and refuses to apply a plan originating from any other commit or root. Applies stay manual but are now mediated. Portable by construction: plain Python, usable locally, under any CI provider, or with none. The drift workflow remains the detector. Runbooks updated to route through the wrapper instead of bare terraform apply.

Mechanism-delta did not fire: active=682 new=26 increased=0 stale=0, all 26 already admitted. No new CI gate, env var, or config key.

Gates: 26 focused tests pass, make lint passes, make verify clean with exactly the 17 known macOS-arm64 pandoc failures.

AC6 remains owned by 794e and 4bfa and is not this ticket's to close.
